items.title: Pando - OpenAI's alternative to Git for source control
items.summary: We built Pando, a new Git backend for our monorepo, to handle more pushes and fetches without changing how our engineers and agents use Git. Pando cut push latency by ~80% and now serves nearly a petabyte of Git data a day. We can grow Git capacity alongside agent usage.

items.title: Embrace: RCE, Address Bar Spoofing and More in Cursor, Codex, Copilot and Claude
items.summary: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, VS Code and Claude Desktop each built a browser into their AI assistant, then enriched it beyond what a normal browser allows. Those enrichments broke the browser threat model, letting a web page or a local file reach the machine behind it. Two issues remain unpatched.
